Test Summary: Test order status transition from Draft/Pending to Cancelled on user cancellation request
Description: This test verifies that an order in 'Draft' or 'Pending' status can be cancelled by the user, changing the status to 'Cancelled'.
Label: regression;negative
Action: Create an order and set its status to 'Draft'
Send a cancellation request for the order
Expected Result: Cancellation request is received and processed

Action: Check the order status

Test Summary: Test inability to cancel an order in Paid, Cancelled, or Shipped status
Description: This test ensures that once an order has reached a status of 'Paid', 'Cancelled', or 'Shipped', it cannot be cancelled.
Label: regression;negative
Action: Set the order status to 'Paid'
Attempt to cancel the order
Set the order status to 'Cancelled'
Attempt to cancel the order again
Expected Result: Cancellation attempt is rejected as order is already 'Cancelled'

Action: Set the order status to 'Shipped'
Attempt to cancel the order

Test Summary: Test status change and notification to users after payment completion with Stripe integration
Description: This test checks if a user receives a notification and the order status is updated to 'Paid' after a successful payment through Stripe, as well as handling payment errors.
Label: integration;regression
Action: Initiate payment through Stripe for an order in 'Pending' status
Simulate a successful Stripe payment
Check the order status
Verify the user notification
Expected Result: User receives a notification confirming payment completion

Action: Simulate a payment error with Stripe
Verify the user is notified about the payment failure
Expected Result: User receives a notification about the payment error

Test Summary: Test order status and notification upon partial or full refund
Description: This test verifies that an order's status is updated and the user is notified when a refund is issued, whether partially or fully, across the integrated features.
Label: integration;regression
Action: Set an order to the 'Paid' status
Initiate a partial refund for the order
Check the order status after partial refund
Expected Result: Order status remains 'Paid', but reflects a partial refund in details

Action: Verify the user notification post partial refund
Expected Result: User receives a notification regarding the partial refund

Action: Initiate a full refund for the order
Check the order status after full refund
Verify the user notification post full refund
Expected Result: User receives a notification regarding the full refund

Test Summary: Test concurrency risk when cancelling and retrying payment transactions across sessions/devices
Description: This test evaluates the concurrency handling mechanism for simultaneous cancellation and payment retry attempts on an order across different sessions or devices.
Label: integration;negative;edge
Action: Initiate a payment process for an order
From a different session/device, send a cancellation request for the same order
Simultaneously, retry payment process from the original session/device
Verify eventual order status
Expected Result: System resolves concurrency and updates to either successfully cancelled or payment completed, based on business rules

Action: Verify user notifications
Expected Result: User receives appropriate notifications based on the final order status outcome
